name: First Contact
description: A small two-player duel over a river.

name: River Line
description: Two bridges, one airfield each. Hold the crossings.

name: Four Corners
description: Four armies on an island, with ports and airfields.

name: Twin Valleys
description: Two valleys split by a ridge, joined by a single road.

name: Crossfire
description: A quick, cramped duel. Fight for the middle.

name: Long Road
description: Forests on either side of one long highway.

name: Salt Flats
description: Open ground and a salt lake. Little cover anywhere.

name: Archipelago
description: Two islands and a strait. Ships and aircraft decide it.

name: Triad
description: Three armies on one round island.

name: Three Rivers
description: Rivers run between the bases into a central lake.

name: Woodland Forts
description: Three forts in a forest, no water at all.

name: Crossroads
description: Four armies, four roads, one square in the middle.

name: Four Lakes
description: Four corners, a lake between each pair of neighbours.

name: Atoll
description: A ring of land around a lagoon. Four ports, four airfields.

name: Hexfall
description: Six armies on a big island. Alliances will not last.

name: Grand Melee
description: Eight armies around a lake. Chaos guaranteed.
